# pmultiqc — Full Reference

> MultiQC plugin for proteomics QC reporting. Published in Mol Cell Proteomics 2026.

## Overview

pmultiqc extends MultiQC with proteomics-specific modules. It parses output files from quantms and quantmsdiann pipelines and generates interactive HTML reports with identification, quantification, and sample-level quality metrics.

## Installation

pip install pmultiqc

Or with quantms pipeline (included automatically in pipeline output).

## Usage

### From quantms pipeline output
multiqc results/ --module pmultiqc

### Standalone with mzTab
multiqc /path/to/mztab/files/ --module pmultiqc

### With SDRF metadata
multiqc results/ --module pmultiqc --cl-config "pmultiqc_sdrf: /path/to/sdrf.tsv"

## Input Formats

- mzTab files: Standard proteomics identification/quantification format
- idXML files: OpenMS identification format
- DIA-NN reports: TSV report from DIA-NN (via quantmsdiann)
- SDRF files: Optional sample metadata for experiment-aware QC

## Report Sections

### Identification Summary
- Total PSMs, peptides, proteins identified per sample
- FDR distribution plots
- Search engine agreement (when multiple engines used)
- Peptide length distribution
- Charge state distribution
- Missed cleavage rates

### Quantification Summary
- Protein intensity distributions (box plots per sample)
- Missing value heatmap
- Coefficient of variation across replicates
- Principal component analysis (PCA)
- Sample correlation matrix

### Experiment Overview
- Sample metadata table (from SDRF)
- Run order effects
- Instrument performance tracking

## Configuration

pmultiqc is configured via MultiQC config or command-line:

# multiqc_config.yaml
pmultiqc_sdrf: /path/to/sdrf.tsv
pmultiqc_version: true

## Output

- multiqc_report.html — Interactive HTML report
- multiqc_data/ — JSON data files for programmatic access

## Example Reports

16 example reports available at: https://pmultiqc.quantms.org/examples/

Covers:
- LFQ experiments (various organisms)
- TMT experiments (multiplexed)
- DIA experiments (library-free and library-based)
- Large-scale reanalysis datasets

## Integration

- quantms pipeline: pmultiqc runs automatically as the final step
- quantmsdiann pipeline: pmultiqc runs automatically as the final step
- Standalone: Can run on any mzTab or DIA-NN report files
- MultiQC ecosystem: Combines with other MultiQC modules (FastQC, etc.)

## Troubleshooting

- Empty report: check that input files are in supported format (mzTab, idXML, or DIA-NN report)
- Missing quantification section: ensure quantification data is present in mzTab (not just identifications)
- Large reports slow to load: use --flat flag to disable interactive plots

## Related Tools

- quantms: DDA proteomics pipeline (https://docs.quantms.org)
- quantmsdiann: DIA proteomics pipeline (https://quantmsdiann.quantms.org)
- mokume: protein quantification library (https://mokume.quantms.org)
- MultiQC: general QC framework (https://multiqc.info)

## Citation

Yue QX et al. Mol Cell Proteomics. 2026;101530. DOI: 10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101530
